segments.title: Is a daddy longlegs a SPIDER?
segments.say: Is a daddy longlegs a spider? Always, never, or it depends? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It depends!
segments.say: It depends! Three animals share the name.

segments.title: Three animals, one name
segments.say: Cellar spiders are spiders. Harvestmen are closer to scorpions. Crane flies are insects.

segments.title: Most venomous spider? MYTH
segments.say: The super-venomous myth? False. Harvestmen have no venom.

segments.title: But some catch FROGS
segments.say: But some have been seen eating frogs!

segments.sub: to the friend who's scared of them
segments.say: Send this to a friend who's scared of them.
